usage.outputShape: body.image_url (hosted JPG on DigitalOcean Spaces CDN); also body.image_description, body.metadata.model, body.metadata.aspect_ratio, body.metadata.replicate_url
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://api.xona-agent.com/base-main/image/flux-2-pro with a JSON body containing a single "prompt" string describing the image you want. Payment is x402 USDC on Base (~$0.05/call); no API key or sign-in needed. The response is synchronous JSON — read the generated image from body.image_url (a permanent CDN JPG). Defaults to 1:1 aspect ratio.
